key.name: sidebar-followed-sources-expanded
key.description: Whether the Followed Sources section in the sidebar is expanded

key.name: sidebar-popular-categories-expanded
key.description: Whether the Popular Categories section in the sidebar is expanded

key.name: sidebar-podcasts-expanded
key.description: Whether the Podcasts section in the sidebar is expanded

key.name: window-width
key.description: The last saved width of the application window

key.name: window-height
key.description: The last saved height of the application window

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the application window is maximized

key.name: news-source
key.description: The currently selected news source (guardian, reddit, bbc, nytimes, wsj, bloomberg, abc, npr, fox)

key.name: category
key.description: The currently selected news category

key.name: personalized-feed-enabled
key.description: Whether the personalized My Feed feature is enabled

key.name: myfeed-custom-only
key.summary: My Feed shows custom sources only
key.description: When true, My Feed will only show custom RSS sources, not built-in sources

key.name: user-location
key.description: User-provided location (city, region, ZIP code, or coordinates) for local news

key.name: user-location-city
key.description: Resolved canonical city name for the provided location (e.g., "San Francisco, California")

key.name: user-location-news-query
key.description: City name used to query local news; the nearest major city when the resolved location is a small town, otherwise the same as user-location-city

key.name: reader-view-enabled
key.description: Whether articles open in a distraction-free extracted reader view by default instead of the full webpage

key.name: card-hover-actions-enabled
key.description: Whether hovering an article card shows quick-open buttons (reader view / preview pane) over its image

key.name: article-click-opens-reader
key.summary: Clicking an article opens reader view directly
key.description: Whether clicking an article card opens it straight into reader view, skipping the preview pane

key.name: reader-font-scale
key.description: Text size multiplier for the reader view, from 0.8 to 1.6

key.name: reader-font-family
key.description: Font family used in reader view: sans, serif, or monospace

key.name: reader-color-scheme
key.description: Background/text color scheme used in reader view: auto, light, sepia, gray, dark, or night

key.name: unread-badges-enabled
key.description: Whether unread count badges are displayed in the sidebar

key.name: unread-badges-categories
key.description: Whether unread count badges are shown on popular category items (e.g., World News, Technology)

key.name: unread-badges-special-categories
key.description: Whether unread count badges are shown on special categories (Front Page, Top Ten, My Feed, Local News, Saved)

key.name: unread-badges-sources
key.description: Whether unread count badges are shown on custom RSS feed sources

key.name: personalized-categories
key.description: List of category IDs included in the personalized feed

key.name: myfeed-included-feeds
key.description: URLs of custom RSS feeds included in My Feed, independent of whether the feed is otherwise enabled

key.name: sports-scores-enabled
key.description: Whether the Sports category shows live score-card sections at all

key.name: sports-live-indicator-enabled
key.description: Whether the sidebar shows a "Live" pill next to the Sports category's count badge while a game is in progress

key.name: disabled-sports-leagues
key.description: List of sports league keys excluded from the Sports category's score-card sections

key.name: sports-league-order
key.description: List of sports league keys in the order their score-card sections should appear in the Sports category

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to automatically refresh feeds ('manual', '15min', '30min', '1hour', '2hours', '4hours')

key.name: onboarding-completed
key.description: Whether the user has completed (or skipped) the first-run welcome dialog

key.name: color-scheme
key.description: Preferred app color scheme ('system', 'light', or 'dark')

key.name: podcast-playback-speed
key.description: Playback rate (1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 2.0) applied to the next episode played

key.name: podcast-skip-seconds
key.description: Seconds to jump forward/back with the mini-player's skip buttons (e.g. 15 or 30)
